# Sazzadul Kabir (Sazzuiux)

> Top Rated web designer & developer, website designer, UI UX designer, product designer, design engineer and brand designer based in Bangladesh, working remotely with clients worldwide. 5+ years designing and building AI SaaS, B2B platforms, CRM/ERP, mobile apps, DTC brands and websites. 350+ projects, Top Rated with 100% Job Success on Upwork. Helped Neuture.ai secure €10M in funding.

## Roles
Web Designer · Website Designer · Web Designer & Developer · Product Designer · Design Engineer · UI UX Designer · Web Developer · Brand Designer

## Services
- Product design: apps and web products that turn users into paying customers
- Web design & development: websites built with Claude, Framer, WordPress, Webflow or custom code
- AI product development: interfaces for AI tools, copilots and agents
- SaaS design: enterprise SaaS, CRM and ERP platforms
- Brand design: complete brand kits, from logo and guidelines to stationery
- Creative campaigns: monthly marketing kits with short reels, social media posts and ad creatives

## Pricing
- The Launch Kit — $1,249 (was $1,449), live in 1–2 weeks: 5–6 responsive pages, custom Figma design (no AI slop), built with Claude AI assistance (code on GitHub / VS Code) or a CMS (WordPress, Framer, Webflow), SEO + AI search ready, SSL & secure forms, analytics setup, 60 days support
- Add-ons: brand identity +$69 · social media campaign (12 post designs, 1 month) +$99 · reels campaign (8–12 reels, 1 month) +$299 · extra page +$99/page
- Payment: 10% to start, 40% after design approval, 50% on launch day
- Custom work (websites beyond 6 pages, mobile apps & SaaS, logo & brand identity): custom quote within 24 hours
- Details: https://sazzuiux.com/pricing/
